blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: The City calls this area South Bonson, not South Meadows; South Meadows is the board sub-area name, bounded in working terms by Hammond Road and the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) rail line north, the Fraser River dike south, and Bonson Road through the middle.
Fraser Way, Sutton Avenue and Barnston View Road form the Osprey Village pocket, with the South Bonson Community Centre at 10932 Barnston View Road.

blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Short-term rentals are not a permitted use under Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 anywhere in Pitt Meadows, so an Osprey Village townhome cannot be used as a short-term rental even if its strata bylaws are silent.
Every strata with five or more lots, including the Osprey Village complexes, must now obtain a depreciation report every five years with no deferral vote.

blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The dike is also the trail: the Fraser River dike top through Shoreline Park at 51 Bonson Road is the walking route for Osprey Village, not a separate park path.
Routes 719 and 722 loop Bonson Road and Fraser Way as one circular service, so the direction on the bus stop sign matters more than the route number.
Edith McDermott Elementary stands at 12178 Bonson Road, north of the Osprey Village pocket, not inside it.
Meadowland Village is not South Meadows stock; listings board-classify that Advent Road complex as Central Meadows.
The CPKC rail line along Hammond Road is the hard north edge of this sub-area and its main noise source.

blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: Pitt Meadows charges a separate drainage rate on top of its general municipal rate, and both are set in the 2026 Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026.
The City collects property taxes and utility fees for water, drainage, diking, sewer, solid waste and green waste in one combined bill.

blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: No West Coast Express station sits in South Meadows; the station for this area is Pitt Meadows Station on Harris Road, reached by the 719/722 Bonson Road loop.
Route 701 runs on Hammond Road at the north edge toward Coquitlam Central Station and Haney Place.

Pitt Meadows Regional Airport (YPK) at 18799 Airport Way, west of Harris Road, has three paved runways, a water runway and a staffed control tower, and offers general aviation and charter flying, not scheduled airline service.

blocks.text: South Meadows Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 first: its Schedule B Urban Floodplain designated flood level is 5.15 metres, and Schedules A and B map which floodplain covers a lot. Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 - Consolidated.pdf
The Drainage System Protection Bylaw No. 2266, 2007 requires a City permit before building within seven metres of the toe of a dike or six metres of the top of bank of a key ditch.

Most of Pitt Meadows outside the urban core is Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) land; Osprey Village itself is urban, but lots backing onto farm parcels to the east sit at the ALR edge — confirm the boundary on the City's official community plan (OCP) maps.

blocks.text: South Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

32 townhomes sold in South Meadows with a median price of $805,000 (the middle half sold between $715,000 and $909,900), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $558 per square foot, a median year built of 2020 and a median strata fee of $351 a month.

faq.a: 8, in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® month-end figures for October 2026. Listings change every day; Jared can tell you what is available now.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in South Meadows?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in South Meadows had a sales ratio of 75% on only 8 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is South Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 18 condos and townhomes sold in South Meadows; Pitt Meadows as a whole recorded 77.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in South Meadows from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: The attached form is the Osprey Village townhome cluster on Fraser Way, Sutton Avenue and Barnston View Road, headed by Nature's Walk on the developer's own page.
faq.q: Is there a condo apartment I can buy in South Meadows?

faq.a: No, because the City prohibition applies city-wide, not complex by complex. A staff report to Council states short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use under the Zoning Bylaw, and the Province's principal-residence requirement also lists Pitt Meadows. A strata that does not mention short-term rentals does not override either layer, so underwrite the home as a residence or a long-term rental only.
faq.q: Can I run an Airbnb from an Osprey Village townhome?

School District 42 (Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows) runs elementary schools at kindergarten to grade 7 and one Pitt Meadows secondary school, Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue, for grades 8 to 12.
faq.q: Which elementary school serves a Bonson Road address?

faq.a: Yes, South Meadows sits behind the Fraser River dike in the City's urban drainage area, and Shoreline Park itself sits on the dike.
